schema.name: Paint name as sold
schema.code: Manufacturer product code, null where the source has none
schema.discontinued: true only for known superseded lines (AP Warpaints original, Speedpaint 1.0)
schema.hex_gradient: Citadel only, optional: official swatch is a gradient [dark ... light]. hex = darkest stop for shades, RGB mean of the stops for everything else
schema.finish: Citadel only, optional: metal | medium | gloss | texture

types.standard: General-purpose opaque acrylic from a brand that does not split base/layer (Vallejo Model/Game Color, AP Fanatic, Pro Acryl, Two Thin Coats, Reaper MSP, etc.)
types.contrast: One-coat translucent paint: Citadel Contrast, AP Speedpaint, Vallejo Xpress, Scale75 Instant, GSW Dipping Ink
types.metallic: Range made entirely of metallics (Citadel metallics keep their Base/Layer type and carry finish='metal' instead)
types.effect: FX paints: fluorescent, colour-shift, weathering, blood/rust/corrosion effects

meta.accuracy_note: Hex values are screen approximations of bottle swatches, not manufacturer colour specs. Washes, contrast/speedpaints, inks, glazes and metallics cannot be represented by a single flat hex; treat those as a rough hue reference only.
